verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants for exposing different versions of a feature to users as part of A/B and multivariate testing, so running experiments is a product capability. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in experiment analysis that compares variants and declares a winner. Impact metrics are documented only as rollout safeguards based on error-rate and latency thresholds, not as per-variant comparison. missing for 10: per-variant metric comparison and winner/statistical analysis, experiment results reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of experimentation workflows.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
